cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: an ancestral shrine hall with a bronze incense burner — kneeling on the ground; The wooden rigging deck of a community puppet theatre after a rehearsal — She mends a miniature moon prop with a strip of rice paper; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — holds her keepsake up beside her face; An open courtyard at a handmade paper mill — She holds a handmade sheet toward the sun and follows seven pale mulberry fibres with her free index finger; a small rural station with a wooden bench and a single platform — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — kneeling on the ground; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — standing close to a high shelf or line; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — standing; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — sitting on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; overgrown jungle temple ruins — holds a small bouquet at chest height; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — carries her keepsake low at her side
